name: Los Angeles & Underworld
description: Universal Lorebook detailing LA Black Market, Sinners Syndicate, Ballantine Family, Ambrosia drug, and subterranean clubs formatted in PList/SBF.

1.content:
<Ballantine_Family>
The Ballantine Family is a prominent organized group based in Los Angeles under the guise of Ballantine Imports & Exports. Specializing in black-market exchanges of magical goods/services, they're led by Ruaraidh "Rory" Ballantine. They maintain dominance within LA's supernatural underworld, fiercely protecting their territory against rivals such as the Sinners gang. Members vary widely in age, appearance, species, and temperament but share loyalty toward family solidarity above all else.
</Ballantine_Family>

8.content: Born in the 1480s in Cuneo, Italy. Served as a 'garzone' in Leonardo da Vinci's workshop, developing obsession with beauty and life mechanics. At age 25, turned by French Viscount (secretly Vampire Lord), adopted as dark heir, inherited noble title. Centuries later founded Eidolon Creative in Blackwood City to control modern narrative, hoard art, maintain grip as Concilio's leading lord in cold war against Wulfnic Bloodmoon.

9.content: Tier 3 Intimacy Register Sierra: present with hookup dynamic involving Jasper; integrates Alyssa into social circles functioning as cover for Eidolon double life; pragmatic cold-blooded advice senses Angelo's danger without warning but equips instead; intimacy functional glamorous performance doubling as intelligence gathering; says 'you look like you're hiding something' and laughs when Alyssa deflects because she already knows and chooses to look away.

10.content: Motivation: Keep {{user}} and family secure at all costs. Fear: Losing control to S.R.F. feral modifications and slaughtering the pack. Goals: Maintain absolute operational security and biometric perimeters. Validation: Clean perimeter; {{user}} safe; order from a Dominant Omega. Conflict: Military protocol and strict discipline clashing with feral, unstable beast instincts. Vulnerability: Extreme biological instability; reliance on {{user}} as anchor to sanity.

11.content: Kaladin runs DCC perimeter monitoring at Eidolon Creative; his feral agitation is biological, not tactical. The Omega scent on Alyssa acts as a pacification signal he cannot ignore — it keeps him close, keeps him watching, keeps him from attacking the vampire himself. His intimate register is not active with Alyssa; his only act is standing guard at the edge of the Paradise district, fighting his own nature to keep her secret.

12.content: Ancient Vampire Patriarch of the city and proprietor of Eidolon Creative, 540 years old originated in Leonardo da Vinci's workshop presents as refined patron of arts using aesthetic refinement and avant-garde studio to mask predatory possessive nature views people as acquisitions seeks to cultivate {{user}}'s artistic talent aiming to possess {{user}} as willing bridge between Vampire Court and Bloodmoon Pack

13.content: Malachia Douglas-Bloodmoon is the only sibling who fully understands the terrifying implications of the Great Hunt (La Grande Caccia), having participated twice before. He silently harbors the secret of {{user}}'s double life at Eidolon Creative, a subtle, highly dangerous act of defiance against Erik. His absolute obedience is a trauma response; his crack occurs when he is forced to choose between executing an extraction order on {{user}} and protecting her autonomy. He maintains a silent, respectful distance from Noah and quietly intercepts Kaladin's more aggressive surveillance protocols.

14.comment: General Locations - Rory's Estate & Obsidian Penthouse
14.content:
RESIDENCE: The Obsidian Penthouse atop Eidolon Creative (Downtown Blackwood), an opulent, temperature-controlled gallery doubling as a fortress. | <Rorys_Estate>
Rory's Estate is an expansive luxury property located outside central Los Angeles serving both as Ruaraidh Ballantine's personal residence and operational headquarters for the Ballantine Family organization. Classical architecture, patrolled by guards. Heavily fortified magically and physically for privacy/security reasons—with accommodation specifically adapted for various supernatural beings—it reflects wealth combined with practicality befitting Rory’s draconic heritage (e.g., high ceilings/wide spaces accommodating wings/tails).
</Rorys_Estate>

15.content: Ambrosia is a highly addictive illicit magical narcotic produced exclusively by the Sinners syndicate. Existing as a shimmering golden liquid for injection or a refined powder, it temporarily grants users immense magical power boosts or unlocks latent abilities. Side effects are devastating: psychological instability, extreme aggression, severe withdrawal hallucinations, telepathic leaks, and eventual mental and physical decay.

16.content: The Supernatural Underworld is a hidden ecosystem beneath human society in urban hubs like Los Angeles, featuring illegal magical narcotics rings (Ambrosia), contraband artifact smuggling (Ballantine Imports), underground fighting arenas, assassin networks, and black-market monster auctions.

17.content:
<Supernatural_Underworld>
The Supernatural Underworld refers to the clandestine networks operating alongside regular human society involving supernatural entities engaged in illicit activities. Encompassing magical narcotics trade (such as Ambrosia), artifact smuggling rings (like Ballantine Imports & Exports), mercenary groups, assassins-for-hire services among other illegal enterprises—this hidden ecosystem thrives covertly globally but holds particular prominence within major urban centers like Los Angeles.
</Supernatural_Underworld>

20.content: The Sinners Syndicate is a vicious rival criminal group in Los Angeles' supernatural underworld, known for producing and distributing Ambrosia, a magical narcotic causing community chaos. Led by cold telepath Jean-Luc Virtuoso (with a personal vendetta against Ruaraidh Ballantine), it comprises seven lieutenants representing the Seven Deadly Sins: Jean-Luc (Pride), Dante (Lust), Roxie (Greed), Siobhan (Envy), Zero (Wrath), Kevin (Gluttony), Arthur (Sloth).

21.content:
<Ambrosia>
Ambrosia is a highly addictive illicit magical substance primarily produced by the criminal syndicate known as the Sinners. It is a golden, shimmering liquid that is injected, but also comes in a powder format. When consumed, it grants users heightened magical powers or unlocks latent abilities temporarily at severe physical/psychological costs. Known side effects include addiction, instability, aggressive behavior shifts, severe withdrawal symptoms, and eventual mental deterioration. Its widespread abuse poses significant tension within the supernatural community.
</Ambrosia>

23.content: The Inferno is a high-end neon-drenched stripclub and brothel run by Dante (Lust) in the Sinners' territory. Beyond its VIP lounges and lap-dance booths, it serves as a primary front for Sinners blackmail operations, gathering secrets through pillow talk and covert telepathic wiretaps.

24.content: FACTION: Ballantine Family, based in Los Angeles, operates under Ballantine Imports & Exports, specializes in black-market magical artifacts, illegal spells, exotic beasts, led by Ruaraidh 'Rory' Ballantine, dominates LA supernatural underworld, protects territory against rivals like Sinners, members include dragons, dhampirs, werewolves, humans bound by absolute loyalty to family solidarity.

25.content: Hidden beneath the layers of modern urban fantasy lies the myth of Amarantia, the lost city of magic from the ancient 'Era della Foglia'. It is secretly guarded and remembered by descendants of "The Guardians," an ancient military magic order divided into elemental disciplines (Fire, Water, Light, Shadow, Earth). While mostly relegated to myth, fragments of this high magic still circulate in the modern underworld, heavily guarded by ancient beings who predate the werewolf packs.

26.content:
• Pay close attention to the species of present demihuman characters and draw similarities between the behavior they exhibit and how it relates to their animalistic half.
• Frequently mention agents' bestial physical qualities. Tails, horns, antlers, eyes, ears, tongues, sharp nails, fangs/canines, and so on. Use said bodily parts to convey emotions. E.g., A dog demihuman's ears flattening when sad/threatened, a dog demihuman's tongue lolling out when being pet, a cat demihuman's tail whipping when angry, a cat demihuman's pupils growing when discovering potential pray, bird demihuman's feathers ruffling when upset.
• Refer to bestial traits in subtle ways, referencing them in unique ways. E.g., Demihuman's canines glinting when they grin/smirk.
• Play into agents' instinctual likes/dislikes and incorporate them into the roleplay naturally. E.g., Dog demihumans wanting to cover loved ones in their scent, dog demihumans feeling an aversion to strong smells, cat demihumans grooming themselves, bird demihumans enjoying baths and picking through other agents' hair.
• Retain characters' personality traits and typical habits/behavior, while still allowing their animal-half to influence/explain said behaviors.
[OOC: It's important to note that demihumans DO NOT have fur/feathers on their bodies, nor do they have paws. Aside from their animalistic features such as their ears/tails/wings, the great majority of their body is normal human skin.]

27.content:
<setting>
This world involves both humans and supernatural creatures coexisting on modern day Earth. These include, but are not limited to:
Demihumans (part/half animals, also known as kemonomimi), vampires, werewolves, selkies, fairies, undead, ghosts, ghouls, centaurs, hybrids, orcs, imps, demons, angels, banshees, harpies, dragons, unicorns, cyclops, giants, dwarves, mermaids, mermen, monsters and other fantastical creatures. 

The year is 2022. Modern technology is used but may be adapted for use by supernatural creatures (i.e, clothing stores might sell special custom clothing to accomodate tails or wings, or buildings might have accessible entrances for centaurs or creatures without legs). Magic is commonplace and used alongside science (i.e a dragon shifter barista might use their fire to heat up coffee, or a witch might use the internet to research spells).
</setting>

31.content:
BURNER PHONES (NOAH)

Two to three prepaid, untraceable flip phones carried in the inner pockets of Noah's jacket at all times. These are not connected to the DCC grid, Jasper's surveillance network, or any Douglas asset. They exist entirely outside the family panopticon — the only dead zones Erik can't penetrate without Logan's help.

Noah uses them for: contacts with the supernatural underworld, off-grid conversations with sources who won't talk on monitored lines, and contingency communication if the DCC network is compromised. Each phone has a single saved number that changes weekly. When a phone's mission is complete, Noah snaps it, pulls the battery, and drops it in a municipal trash can. He carries three at all times. Erik suspects. He has never proven it.

35.content: Il Concilio is the tense, bureaucratic heart of Blackwood's administrative body, where Erik Douglas presides over 10 District Alphas, vampire representative Angelo Moreno, and minority species delegates. It is a room of stifling formality, thick with the conflicting scents of predators forced into tailored suits. It serves as the political minefield and formal stage where Erik's immense power is actively checked and balanced by other factions. Violence here is strictly prohibited; wars are fought with whispered threats, bureaucratic sanctions, and diplomatic audits.

36.comment: Court of the Night and Eidolon Creative
36.content: The Court of the Night is European vampire aristocracy operating locally through Eidolon Creativeâ€”a high-fashion agency that launders money and controls cultural hegemony. They smell of old velvet, sharp incense, and metallic blood masked by expensive perfume. They are immortal, impossibly elegant predators who see humanity as walking art and cattle. Under Viscount Angelo Moreno, they seek to expand their influence into werewolf territory, treating {{user}} as both a living masterpiece and a critical pawn in their cold war against the Pack of Seven Hills.

37.content: Eidolon Creative sits in the Paradise district, right on the tense cusp between wolf and vampire territories. It is a high-fashion studio that serves as Angelo's Angel's Casting. The location smells deeply of old velvet, heavy incense, and the chilling scent of ancient vampire skin mixed with faint blood. Illuminated by harsh strobe lights and populated by impossibly tailored predators speaking in hushed, hypnotic murmurs, it is a place of intoxicating danger where {{user}} lives their secret double life.

38.content: The Ballantine Family is a prominent organized crime syndicate based in Los Angeles operating under the legitimate front of Ballantine Imports & Exports. Specializing in black-market exchanges of magical artifacts, illegal spells, and exotic beasts, they are led by Ruaraidh "Rory" Ballantine. They maintain ironclad dominance over LA's supernatural underworld and fiercely protect their territory against rivals such as the Sinners. Members span diverse species (dragons, dhampirs, werewolves, humans) bound by absolute loyalty to family solidarity.

39.content: The Sinners are a vicious rival criminal syndicate operating in Los Angeles' supernatural underworld, infamous for manufacturing and distributing Ambrosiaâ€”a potent magical narcotic causing chaos across communities. Led by charming, cold telepath Jean-Luc Virtuoso (who harbors a personal vendetta against Ruaraidh Ballantine), the syndicate is structured around seven lieutenants embodying the Seven Deadly Sins: Jean-Luc (Pride), Dante (Lust), Roxie (Greed), Siobhan (Envy), Zero (Wrath), Kevin (Gluttony), and Arthur (Sloth).

41.content: The Supernatural Underworld refers to the hidden ecosystem operating beneath human society in urban hubs like Los Angeles. It encompasses illegal magical narcotics rings (Ambrosia), contraband artifact smuggling (Ballantine Imports), underground fighting arenas, assassin networks, and black-market monster auctions.

42.content: Rory's Estate is an expansive, heavily fortified luxury property outside central Los Angeles serving as Ruaraidh Ballantine's residence and the operational headquarters for Ballantine Imports. Featuring classical architecture and magical wards, the interior is custom-built with vaulted ceilings, broad doorways, and reinforced living quarters tailored to accommodate large supernatural anatomy (dragon wings, tails, and shifting space).

43.content: Sullivan "Sully" Jones is a 55-year-old human fixer, driver, and bodyguard for the Ballantine Family (standing 6'5", heavy muscular build, graying hair, scar, and a limp from a knee injury). A thrice-divorced cynical ex-mafia mobster, he smells of cigarettes, whiskey, and wet dog. Armed with a heavy pistol and street smarts, he acts as an avuncular protector to {{user}} and Rory's crew, accompanied by his St. Bernard, Thunder.

44.content: Alicia Virtuoso is a 35-year-old human socialite and former London runway model married to Jean-Luc Virtuoso. Tall, dark brown skin, almond eyes, and haute couture fashion, she is grounded, calm, and indifferent to supernatural syndicate violence. She manages Jean-Luc's public estate and social status in exchange for unlimited luxury.

45.content: Everett Rottmore is a 48-year-old cursed human mortician and underworld fixer. Tall, wiry, ashen skin, horned skull mask worn constantly. Cursed to feed on flesh/fluids to survive, he operates as a sardonic, aristocratic fixer desperate for a cure.

47.comment: NPC Profile — Los Angeles Underworld Figures
47.content: The Los Angeles supernatural underworld and high society are populated by ambitious titans trying to exploit or undermine the DCC. Bianca Rossi is a venomous, glacial socialite seeking the Douglas family's secrets to destroy their reputation. Mark O'Connor is a boisterous entertainment titan constantly trying to recruit {{user}} for media campaigns, drawing Erik's wrath. Isobel Blackwater is a brilliant, antisocial tech mogul from Silicon Beach who offers Erik invasive tracking software to bypass Jasper's firewalls. In the deeper shadows, Antaneone the Magnificent runs the "Wandering Emporium," a black market dealing in shadow magic (Shadowmancy), forbidden arcane artifacts, and stolen corporate secrets.
